name: Phantom of the Amphitheater
description: The Phantom of the Amphitheater is the beann'shie of Elsa de Longpré, a celebrated actress murdered during a performance at the restored Seidhe Llygad Amphitheater.
story: Her final audience never left; it merely learned to applaud from beyond the grave.
lore: Elsa's violent death bound her to the stage she once commanded. Her haunting silenced the amphitheater for generations, and only a carefully reconstructed performance could draw the phantom into the open.
habitat: Places bound to a violent death

source.file: The Witcher 3: Blood and Wine bestiary
